title: Implement LCI access levels and consume access_levels.json
description: test/vectors/access_levels.json (LCI 17.6.3) unconsumed: no AccessLevel model exists in python/src/lichen. Implement + pytest consumer.
close_reason: LCI access-control oracle shipped: lichen/coap/access.py with AccessLevel ordering, transport->level bindings (usb/serial/ipc=admin, ble/wifi=standard), longest-prefix resource rules with per-method minimum levels, and the vector-pinned error-code conventions (4.04 unknown resource before level checks, 4.05 method-not-on-resource regardless of level, 4.01 underprivileged mutation/observe-below-standard, 4.03 underprivileged /diag/raw/* read). 32 pytest cases consume every section of access_levels.json (transport_binding, all three level matrices, edge_cases incl. diag-raw subpath, put-status-blocked-all, wellknown discovery). Full-file coverage; ruff/format clean.
